description: Deterministically convert AMPscript to Marketing Cloud Next (MCN) Handlebars using the exactness model built from ampscript-data: exact functions (a drop-in Handlebars helper exists) become {{helper …}}; approximate functions (a helper exists but the call shape differs, e.g. ContentBlockByKey → getContentBlock) become a MANUAL_REWRITE_REQUIRED comment naming the closest helper; functions with no MCN counterpart become a plain MANUAL_REWRITE_REQUIRED comment. Procedural AMPscript blocks (SET/VAR/IF/FOR) have no Handlebars equivalent and are flagged. Use the convertAmpscriptToHandlebars PROMPT for AI-enhanced handling of flagged sections.

code.description: The AMPscript code to convert to MCN Handlebars.

name: convertAmpscriptToHandlebars
